services.name: Six Hour Luxury Pontoon Adventure
services.desc: Overview Enjoy an extended, unhurried day on the water aboard a private luxury tritoon—ideal for groups who want more time to relax, float, and explore Crab Island without feeling rushed. This 6-hour pontoon charter is perfect for bachelorette parties, girls’ trips, families, and groups who want flexibility and a laid-back pace. Our Avalon Catalina luxury tritoon features plush seating, double biminis for shade, Bluetooth sound, and a smooth, stable ride—making it one of the most comfortable pontoon experiences on the Emerald Coast.
